gates.C02-PARTIAL: >= 1 unique undetected case with GPU evaluator PARTIAL, alone_px >= min_target_pixels, online class per the v1 mapping (exact centre verdict when centre-robust), oracle-agreeing
gates.C02-CENTRE: >= 1 unique undetected case with GPU evaluator CENTRE_ONLY, alone_px >= min_target_pixels, centre-robust, online OCCLUSION_CENTRE_EVIDENCE, oracle-agreeing
gates.C02-SENSOR-NONINTERFERENCE: sensors_s_l1c and sensors_s_l1d deliver bitwise identical renders (d2_renders) and detection
